description: Declare inputs and outputs on the WorkbookAPI hosted API. Sends the model id and the input/output arrays given, including their names, workbook references, types and constraints. Replaces the whole interface and returns the API interface result. The API validates the declarations. Requires an admin key. Bills no calculation scenarios.

inputs.description: Input declarations, each {name, ref, type} with type number, string or boolean, and optionally min and max (numbers) or allowed (a list of permitted values); ref is one constant or blank cell, or a name for one.

model_id.description: Hosted model id returned by upload_model.

outputs.description: Output declarations, each {name, ref}; ref is the workbook cell, range or name to return.

name: set_interface
